detail: Article 1(14) of the consolidated text of Decision 1999/70/EC approves PricewaterhouseCoopers Limited as the external auditor of the Central Bank of Cyprus for the financial years 2018 to 2022.
source_title: Council Decision 1999/70/EC on the external auditors of the national central banks, consolidated text of 26 October 2021 (EUR-Lex, Publications Office of the European Union)

detail: Article 1(15) of the consolidated text of Decision 1999/70/EC approves KPMG as the external auditor of the Central Bank of Malta for the financial years 2019 to 2025.
source_title: Council Decision 1999/70/EC on the external auditors of the national central banks, consolidated text of 26 October 2021 (EUR-Lex, Publications Office of the European Union)

detail: Article 1(7) of the consolidated text of Decision 1999/70/EC approves Ernst & Young SA as the external auditor of the Banque centrale du Luxembourg for the financial years 2019 to 2023.
source_title: Council Decision 1999/70/EC on the external auditors of the national central banks, consolidated text of 26 October 2021 (EUR-Lex, Publications Office of the European Union)

auditor: Al-Aiban, Al-Osaimi & Partners of Ernst & Young; and KPMG, Safi Al-Mutawa & Partners
detail: The independent auditors' report in the Central Bank of Kuwait's annual report for the fiscal year ended 31 March 2013 is signed jointly by Waleed Abdullah Al-Oseimi of Al-Aiban, Al-Osaimi & Partners of Ernst & Young and Safi Abdulaziz Al-Mutawa of KPMG, Safi Al-Mutawa & Partners, and is dated 3 May 2013.

The independent auditor's report on the National Bank of Kazakhstan's consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 was issued by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, signed in Almaty and dated 3 April 2026.
source_title: Consolidated Financial Statements for the Year Ended 31 December 2025 (National Bank of the Republic of Kazakhstan)

detail: The Bulgarian National Audit Office states that its audit mandate covers the budget expenditures of the Bulgarian National Bank and their management, and the formulation of any annual surplus of BNB income over expenditure that is payable into the state budget, and that it reports to the National Assembly on the Bank's budgetary expenditure.

The audit report (Rapport d'audit du Commissaire Controleur) on the BCEAO's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 is signed by Deloitte Cote d'Ivoire, with partner Frederick Bledou, dated Abidjan 25 February 2026.
source_title: Etats financiers de la BCEAO au 31 decembre 2025 (Banque Centrale des Etats de l'Afrique de l'Ouest)

detail: elDinero reports on the Banco Central de la Republica Dominicana's position as at 31 December 2023 citing the report of the independent auditors KPMG.
source_title: Deficit cuasifiscal del Banco Central dominicano (elDinero)

year: annually, under the Bank of Zambia Act No. 5 of 2022
detail: Paragraph 15(2) of the First Schedule to the Bank of Zambia Act, No. 5 of 2022 provides that the accounts of the Bank shall be audited annually or whenever necessary by the Auditor-General or an auditor appointed by the Auditor-General.
source_title: The Bank of Zambia Act, No. 5 of 2022 (Government of Zambia, via Laws.Africa)

detail: The general information section of the Bank of Mongolia's 2020 financial statements lists the Bank's auditors as Ernst & Young Mongolia Audit LLC, Certified Public Accountants; the statements were authorised for issue on 31 March 2021.
